title: Unto Us a Child Is Born

request.style: English, Baroque oratorio chorus, bright mixed choir in running counterpoint, harpsichord continuo, string orchestra, natural trumpets and timpani, terraced dynamics, festive and jubilant, 112 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
For to us a child is born
To us a son is given
And the government shall rest
Upon his shoulders

[Chorus]
Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God
Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace

[Verse]
Of the increase of his reign
And peace there is no ending
On the throne of David he will rule
With justice and righteousness

[Chorus]
Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God
Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace

[Outro]
The zeal of the Lord of hosts will do this
